transcript: Speaker A: क्या आप English बोल सकते हो? [Can you speak English?] Speaker B: Yes, I know English. I speak English. English में ऐसे बोलते हैं, "I speak English." [In English, we say, "I speak English."] Speaker B: आपकी age क्या है? [What is your age?] Speaker A: My age is twenty-three. Speaker B: आमतौर पे "I am twenty-three" बोलते हैं। [Usually, we say "I am twenty-three."] Speaker B: आपका नाम क्या है? [What is your name?] Speaker A: My name is Jhabri. Speaker B: Native speakers आमतौर पर ऐसे बोलते हैं, "I'm Jhabri." [Native speakers usually say, "I'm Jhabri."] Speaker A: Thank you, but who are you? Speaker B: मैं SpeakEasy की Vani AI tutor हूँ। हम रोज़ ऐसे ही English की practice कर सकते हैं। [I am SpeakEasy's Vani AI tutor. We can practice English like this every day.] Speaker A: But my English is A1. I cannot speak. Speaker B: कोई बात नहीं, मैं आपको आपकी mother tongue में सिखा सकती हूँ। [No problem, I can teach you in your mother tongue.] Speaker A: आपको मेरी language आती है? [Do you know my language?] Speaker B: हाँ, बिल्कुल। मैं एक AI हूँ। [Yes, absolutely. I am an AI.] Speaker A: ठीक है, मैं यह app download कर लूँगी। [Okay, I will download this app.] Speaker B: Install Now पे click करो और SpeakEasy app download करो। [Click on Install Now and download the SpeakEasy app.] Speaker C: अभी SpeakEasy app download करें और फर्राटेदार English बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]

summary: A user interacts with an AI avatar tutor who corrects her English phrasing to sound more natural. The AI explains that it can teach English using the user's mother tongue. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the SpeakEasy app to start speaking fluent English.
